Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-figure PIXEL ART walk sheet for the established native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input 1 is the EXACT APPEARANCE, PROPORTIONS, COLOR and EQUIPMENT master. Input 2 is another accepted/reviewed figure used ONLY as MOVEMENT/GRIP and native game camera guide. Never copy the guide's face, clothing, body build, equipment design or colors.
Redraw locomotion only. Keep rigid body proportions, original material values and native pixel-art finish. NO extra light on the walking figure, brightened/whitened skin, pinkened red cloth, glossy metal, rim lighting, glow or effects. Preserve deep original shadows and matte muted materials.
Layout: EXACTLY 3 columns x 3 rows of equal square cells, row-major. Eight DISTINCT ordered walking figures in cells 1–8, ninth relaxed idle. All figures complete, with generous genuinely transparent margins around head, fingertips, weapon ends and feet. No clipping, inter-cell overlap or scale changes. Camera, zoom, head size and body construction constant.
Animation: first eight cells are one two-step cycle at 400ms per step / 800ms full cycle. 1 left foot reaches contact, right trails; 2 weight settles over planted left; 3 right foot passes CLOSE under hips with LOW knee lift; 4 right reaches next contact; 5 opposite/right foot contact; 6 settles over planted right; 7 left passes close underneath hips; 8 left reaches contact ready to repeat 1. Eight distinct meaningful phases. Keep planted feet credible and stride compact. No sideways splaying, scissor gait, high knees, skating, dancing, broad jumps or alternating whole-body zoom. Torso, head, arms and held equipment move coherently with very little bob. Boots or feet must read beneath cloth. Draw each entire pose, never graft legs or shear pixel bands.
Style: exact master's dark crisp pixel-art contours and deliberate readable clusters at native game scale, about 55–60px tall. Not a smooth HD painting, 3D rendering, airbrush, blur, grain or photographic texture. Any colored fringe dots in the old master are export specks, not new emissive lights or anatomy.
Background genuinely transparent alpha ZERO including limb gaps. NO floor, cast shadow, matte, checkerboard, grid, border, text, labels or watermark.
Subject: The exact red hooded cultist in appearance master: red pointed hood and shoulder scarf, small shadowed gray face, charcoal-gray sleeves and torso, brown belt, hanging red split tabard, gray/dark trousers and brown leather boots. Preserve original long thin dark firearm held horizontally across the chest in TWO hands, same barrel thickness and stock silhouette. The barrel points toward SCREEN LEFT in the front master (character's anatomical RIGHT), and toward SCREEN RIGHT when seen from behind. Keep this exact direction ownership and the original two grips. No white skull mask, helmet, new armor, bandolier, backpack or extra weapon. This master has a slightly slimmer rifle than other cultists; do not bulk it up from the movement guide.
Direction: FRONT / slight front three-quarter view walking SOUTH/DOWN toward viewer, same native slightly elevated game projection in every walking cell. Keep the master's recognizable face/hood angle and pose while forming real compact steps.
